details.review: Both bolts in S, the carrier pivot, planet bearing, gear mesh and the distinct frame-spin and carried-axle labels are visible. Independent PNG-only reader: H carries the axle CCW. Its upward velocity at the right-hand position must be canceled at the left contact against fixed S. The planet spins CCW in the frame. Selected C.
